info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Funds Confirmation Consents API
info.description: The Funds Confirmation Consents API enables financial institutions to manage consents related to funds confirmation requests. This endpoint provides a mechanism for retrieving the status and details of specific consent agreements associated with funds availability. Typically utilized by banking applications and payment service providers, this API facilitates seamless interaction with customer consent data to ensure compliance and enhance user experience. Developers can use this API to support functions that require verification of consent before processing financial transactions.

get.summary: Retrieve funds confirmation consent by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the details of a specific funds confirmation consent using its unique identifier. It provides essential information related to the consent, which is necessary for further processing of funds confirmation requests.

requestBody.description: This request body retrieves the funds confirmation consents for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. It should include necessary parameters to ensure proper verification and retrieval of consent information.
